entities.summary: Morbid Angel is an American death metal band based in Tampa, Florida, formed in 1983 by guitarist, primary composer and sole remaining original member Trey Azagthoth, vocalist and bassist Dallas Ward, and drummer Mike Browning. It was one of the first bands to incorporate guttural vocals, up-tempo blast beats, multiple tempo changes and a dark atmosphere. Morbid Angel was also the first death metal band to experience mainstream success in connection with being signed to Giant Records in 1992, heavy rotation of its music videos on MTV, and having the music video for the song "God of Emptiness" shown on an episode of Beavis and Butt-Head.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Morbid Angel's influence on death metal and extreme music helped shape the genre's sound and style, contributing to its mainstream success in the early 1990s. The band's music videos received heavy rotation on MTV, introducing death metal to a wider audience.
